newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Renong falls on mixed factors-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Renong falls on mixed factors-dealers.

text.p: The stock of Malaysia's Renong Bhd fell in morning dealings on a mix of factors, dealers and analysts said.
Around 0255 GMT, the stock was down 12 cents or 3.39 percent to 3.42 ringgit, on the market's second heaviest volume of 3.4 million shares traded.
Many said they had not heard of any news or rumours linked to the slide.
"It's very aggressive selling. But I have not heard of anything. People at the company said there's no news to affect the stock," said an institutional dealer at a local brokerage.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Other dealers and analysts said the Renong stable of companies had a good run-up recently and was merely falling on profit taking by institutions due to the lacklustre performance of the market.
Some analysts said the fall may be due to perceptions that Renong has added to its liabilities with its recent announcement of a put option on 112 million Time Engineering Bhd shares.
The move was part of an elaborate arrangement to help group company Time fund some acquisitions.
"In some ways there is a contingent liability if the share price doesn't perform," said one research director.
Time stock was off four cents to 4.16 on volume of only 4,000 shares.
